display_information.name: Hub
display_information.description: Private FFSA Hub assistant for ministry leaders.
display_information.long_description: The FFSA Hub's private assistant for ministry leaders. DM it to see your team's Hub access, look up one person's access, give or remove a Hub permission for someone in a ministry you lead, resend a Hub invite to someone who hasn't set up their account, or report a problem to the Hub team. Every change waits for you to press Confirm. It only answers ministry leaders, and only in a direct message.
